newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldier killed in Lebanon blast.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldier killed in Lebanon blast.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and three were wounded on Tuesday when guerrillas set off a roadside bomb near their patrol in south Lebanon, pro-Israeli militia sources said.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah guerrilla movement claimed responsibility for the attack.
The sources said the blast occurred as Israeli soldiers were travelling on foot on the road between Marqaba and Odeissi deep in the central sector of the zone.
Hizbollah leads an Islamic Resistance committed to ousting Israeli troops from the 15-km (nine-mile) south Lebanon border area.
